questions.question: What happened on the day the enemies hoped to destroy the Jews?
options: Both sides agreed to make peace and laid down their arms
The Jews were scattered abroad to all of the far provinces
The reverse occurred and the Jews overcame their enemies
The king himself stepped in and stopped all of the fighting
questions.answer: The reverse occurred and the Jews overcame their enemies
